quiz.en: And remember, there's also a quiz and worksheet available on our website, bbclearningenglish.com.
quiz.zh: 记住，我们的网站bbclearningenglish.com上也提供有测验和练习单。

quiz.en: But first, our quiz question. World leaders promised in 2015 to limit global temperature rises.
quiz.zh: 但首先，是我们的问答环节。世界领导人在 2015 年承诺限制全球气温上升。

quiz.en: And remember, you'll find all the vocabulary and a quiz on our website, bbclearningenglish.com.
quiz.zh: 记住，你可以在我们的网站 bbclearningenglish.com 上找到所有的词汇和一个小测验。

quiz.en: OK. Georgie, I think it's time now for the answer to my quiz question.
quiz.zh: 好的。Georgie，我想现在是揭晓测验题答案的时候了。

quiz.en: And remember – you'll find all the vocabulary and a quiz on our website, bbclearningenglish.com.
quiz.zh: 请记住——你可以在我们的网站 bbclearningenglish.com 上找到所有的词汇和一个小测验。

quality.en: Today, people care more about freedom and flexibility and the quality of your life.
quality.zh: 如今，人们更在乎自由、灵活性以及生活质量。

quality.en: If something has potential, it already has the qualities or abilities to do something.
quality.zh: 如果某事物具有 potential，它就已经具备做某事的品质或能力。

quality.en: As a result, soil quality did decline and food became harder to produce.
quality.zh: 结果，土壤质量确实下降了，粮食也变得更难生产。

quality.en: Gulf cities like Dubai want a reputation as places with a good quality of life.
quality.zh: 像迪拜这样的海湾城市希望树立起生活质量良好的声誉。

quality.en: It's going to determine the food and air and water quality that you receive.
quality.zh: 它将决定你所接触的食物、空气和水质。

qualification.en: I appreciate your qualification, and you phrased it better than I did just now.
qualification.zh: 我很欣赏你这个补充说明，而且你刚才表达得比我更贴切。

qualification.en: So people trust standardized tests like IELTS or the Cambridge English qualifications.
qualification.zh: 因此，人们信任像雅思或剑桥英语证书这样的标准化测试。

qualification.en: University entrance exams. Even your driving test and professional qualifications you need for your job.
qualification.zh: 大学入学考试。甚至还有你的驾照考试以及工作所需的专业资格认证。

qualification.en: Well, maybe? The UK still offers world class universities and great qualifications, but the message is changing.
qualification.zh: 嗯，也许吧？英国仍然提供世界级的大学和优秀的学历，但传达的信息正在改变。

qualification.en: CV is short for curriculum vitae, a document listing someone's education, qualifications and work experience, which they write when looking for a job.
qualification.zh: CV 是 curriculum vitae 的缩写，即个人简历，是一份列出某人教育背景、资历和工作经验的文件，在找工作时撰写。

quarrel.en: Our audio production team includes Annie Murphy-Paul, Kristen Wong, Laura Quarrel, Ryan Katz, Andrew Chadwick, and Nick Woodbury.
quarrel.zh: 我们的音频制作团队包括 Annie Murphy-Paul、Kristen Wong、Laura Quarrel、Ryan Katz、Andrew Chadwick 和 Nick Woodbury。

quarrel.en: And finally, a barney is a loud argument or quarrel.
quarrel.zh: 最后，barney 是指大声的争吵或口角。

quarrel.en: But no matter how annoyed you are, you probably don't want to get into a barney – a loud argument or quarrel.
quarrel.zh: 但无论你有多生气，你可能都不想卷入一场 barney——即大声的争吵或口角。

quarrel.en: But it couldn’t go on forever. By late summer, the accusations had become a form of village retribution, a way to settle scores with quarrelling neighbours.
quarrel.zh: 但这不可能永远持续下去。到了夏末，指控已经演变成一种村庄内部的报复手段，成了与争吵不休的邻居了结恩怨的方式。

queue.en: Your call is important to us. You are number 89 in the queue.
queue.zh: 你的来电对我们很重要。你在队列中排第89位。

queue.en: The backlog — the number of cases sitting in this queue — has roughly doubled since before the pandemic.
queue.zh: 积压案件的数量——也就是排在这条队伍里的案件数——比疫情之前大约翻了一番。

queue.en: We like fight for it. Like the 40 minute queue is what makes us so grateful for the roller coaster.
queue.zh: 我们为它奋斗。就像40分钟的排队让我们对过山车如此感激。

queue.en: I'm Phil. And I'm Pippa. Have you ever phoned up a company and had your call held in a queue?
queue.zh: 我是Phil。我是Pippa。你有没有给哪家公司打过电话，然后被放在队列里等待？

queue.en: Long queues for bread and fuel became common.
queue.zh: 排长队买面包和燃料变得很普遍。

queen.en: This was 1977. The year of the Sex Pistols and the Queen's Silver Jubilee.
queen.zh: 那是 1977 年。性手枪乐队成立以及女王登基银禧庆典的年份。

queen.en: Let's hear some reasons for why we should breakfast like a king or queen.
queen.zh: 让我们听听为什么我们应该像国王或女王一样吃早餐的一些原因。

queen.en: There's a red queen hypothesis, which is that we undergo sexual selection to mix up our genes.
queen.zh: 有一个“红皇后假说”，即我们通过有性生殖来打乱基因组合。

queen.en: In many societies, powerful dogs became symbols of status and authority, owned only by elites, kings and queens.
queen.zh: 在许多社会中，威猛的犬只成为了地位和权力的象征，只有权贵、国王和女王才能拥有它们。

queen.en: I grew up in Queens. He's from the Pacific Northwest.
queen.zh: 我在皇后区长大。他来自太平洋西北地区。

quantity.en: What she sees are protein products in abundance – in other words, in large quantities.
quantity.zh: 她看到的是大量的蛋白质产品——换句话说，数量极多。

quantity.en: Aristocratic meals contained enormous quantities of meat, elaborate dishes, sugar, and imported spices.
quantity.zh: 贵族的餐食包含大量的肉类、精致的菜肴、糖和进口香料。

quantity.en: And people in northeast England and South Wales had been burning it in small quantities for generations.
quantity.zh: 英格兰东北部和南威尔士的人们世世代代一直在小批量地燃烧它。

quantity.en: Vast quantities of gold began to be exported out of Brazil.
quantity.zh: 大量的黄金开始被运出巴西。

quantity.en: Quality matters more than quantity. Good question askers are active and they ask questions because they’re curious.
quantity.zh: 质量比数量更重要。擅长提问的人积极主动，他们因为好奇而提问。

quote.en: He had described theology as, and I quote, “a rhapsody of ill-invented nonsense”.
quote.zh: 他将神学描述为（我引用原话）“一首胡编乱造的无稽之谈狂想曲”。

quote.en: This is something that hadn't happened before, which is you misquoted me, but improved the quote.
quote.zh: 这是以前没发生过的事情，就是你引用错了我的话，但改进了那句引语。

quote.en: Quote, "I am seeing the signs. I need to be close to Jehovah.
quote.zh: 引述一下，“我看到了这些迹象。我需要亲近耶和华。

quote.en: But, so, I did say that by way of, I wanted to find the specific quote.
quote.zh: 不过，我刚才这么说是想引出——我想找到那段具体的引文。

quote.en: He felt pressure to present himself as a quote unquote 'real man'.
quote.zh: 他感到有压力要把自己塑造成所谓的(quote unquote)'真正的男人'。

qualify.en: Importantly, time alone will no longer be enough to qualify for indefinite leave to remain.
qualify.zh: 重要的是，单靠时间将不再足以满足获得无限期留居许可的条件。

qualify.en: Richard actually qualified for a Veterans Administration Loan at a really good rate.
qualify.zh: 理查德其实有资格申请退伍军人管理局（VA）的贷款，利率非常优惠。

qualify.en: Some groups are likely to qualify faster, but as of the time I’m writing this, the government has not clarified.
qualify.zh: 某些群体可能会更快符合条件，但截至我写下这些内容时，政府尚未明确说明。

qualify.en: But does this qualify as an earthquake, scientifically speaking?
qualify.zh: 但这在科学意义上算得上地震吗？

qualify.en: So Wall Street had to find more people to take out mortgages, which meant lending to people who never would have qualified before.
qualify.zh: 因此，华尔街不得不寻找更多的人来申请抵押贷款，这意味着要向那些以前绝无资格获得贷款的人发放贷款。

quantify.en: So Bentham was one of the first to dream of quantifying happiness.
quantify.zh: 所以边沁是第一批梦想将幸福量化的人之一。

quest.en: In 1925, at the age of 58, he ventured deep into the Amazon rainforest on a quest for what he believed was a lost city—a place he called “Z.”
quest.zh: 1925 年，58 岁的他深入亚马逊雨林，寻找他坚信存在的一座失落之城——一个他称之为“Z”的地方。

quarterly.en: This consistent quarterly structure would make the calendar predictable, and an extra day—a year-end holiday outside the regular calendar—would be added to balance the total.
quarterly.zh: 这种一致的季度结构将使日历具有可预测性，并且会增加额外的一天——一个位于常规日历之外的年终假期——来平衡总量。

quit.en: I want to encourage you to just quit. Or at least think about quitting.
quit.zh: 我想鼓励你直接放弃。或者至少考虑一下放弃。

quit.en: I want to encourage you to just quit. Or at least think about quitting.
quit.zh: 我想鼓励你直接放弃。或者至少考虑一下放弃。

quit.en: The BBC headline, for example, was: “United Arab Emirates to Quit Oil Cartel OPEC.”
quit.zh: 例如，BBC的头条新闻是：“阿拉伯联合酋长国将退出石油卡特尔OPEC。”

quit.en: Like, why can't you quit your job? Like, like, you know what I mean?
quit.zh: 就像，你为什么不能辞职？就像，你知道我的意思吗？

quit.en: Johnson eventually resigned after dozens of ministers, senior politicians, quit his government.
quit.zh: 在数十名部长和高级政治人物退出其政府后，Johnson最终辞职了。

quotation.en: It is probably Quotations from Chairman Mao or The Little Red Book.
quotation.zh: 它很可能是《毛主席语录》或称《小红书》。

quotation.en: However, the Bible, the Quran, and Quotations from Chairman Mao are not really commercial bestsellers.
quotation.zh: 然而，《圣经》、《古兰经》和《毛主席语录》并非真正意义上的商业畅销书。
